reviews.title: Helping so far
reviews.text: It’s been 1 day and 4 hrs and it feels good to look back at the app and see my progress FOR FREE

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text: Too many ads to access any function of the ap. Even if you watch the ads you have to force close to get back and then you are met with a new ad-some which are alcohol focused which is off putting

reviews.title: JJ
reviews.text: downloaded the app but then when I asked for assistance and relapse help, I ran into a pay wall

reviews.title: The app I always needed
reviews.text: This is exactly what I’ve been looking for since I’ve been trying apps. The statistics are so satisfying in making you feel like you’re actually making progress which makes all the difference for me. The app is wildly simple but completely changed my feelings and efforts quickly with minimal effort. I just bought the pro version and wanted to say, absolutely try this app, I hope it helps everyone as much as it already has me.

reviews.title: Used to be great, now it’s nothing but ads. Any click prompts an ad it’s excessive for any app.
reviews.text: It also will give you notifications of 12 hours, despite you having 955 days in addition to those 12 hours. Could be disheartening to someone newly sober. It provides some decent health data hence the additional star, but having to wait through a game or app ad for one minute to see anything. And then wait another minute for another long ad if you click an item for more detail. It’s basically not a functional app unless you’re willing to pay. I’m biased though, I was using it years ago before it turned into spam.

reviews.title: Unskippable Ads for Gambling on an app for addicts ??

reviews.title: Worthless because of ads
reviews.text: So many ads you can’t actually do anything. Why? There’s no option to close out of the ads either so I’m just staring at a screen waiting for it to change and it won’t. Worthless

reviews.title: Good but app has issues
reviews.text: I like this app but some of the percentages are off. It’ll say I’m 60% of the way to a milestone that I’m actually  98% of the way too. App has weird glitches like that quite frequently

reviews.title: This app is a trigger!!
reviews.text: This app will cause u to drink bc of the ads and not able to get pass them!!

reviews.title: Not usable
reviews.text:
I used this app in the past and just redownloaded it. You can’t do anything within the app without another ad popping up.  Every time you try to move around in the app to look at new information you have to go through another ad. Every time! Even to just go to settings to adjust your information. 
I understand a few ads, but this is over the top bad, and it destroys the app’s purpose.

reviews.title: Literally an uncloseable ad for pressing any button
reviews.text: App is an absolute blight to use. Never in my LIFE have I gotten an ad that I CANNOT close for pressing the settings button. What a waste of space on the internet, devs should be absolutely ashamed

reviews.title: Please get rid of the ads!!!
reviews.text: On December 25, 2025 I will be four years sober. I am proud of myself. I was able to do it cold turkey, but for somebody who may have trouble quitting, putting ads on an app could discourage them and caused them to drink. I honestly think in an app that is used for sobriety. It should be nice and clean and with NO ADS. I think at the end of the day the ads on your app can cause someone to relapse.

reviews.title: Constant Ads
reviews.text: I couldn’t even get to anything good because anything I clicked on, there was a new game add, and it took so long to be able to leave the ad.

reviews.title: Junk - Do not download.
reviews.text: Developers lied when they responded previously that the ads are skippable after 6 seconds. A once decent app is total unusable garbage now.

reviews.title: Too many game ads!
reviews.text: Way too many game ads! You can’t even use the app. It used to be good.

reviews.title: Ad situation is now ridiculous
reviews.text: The ads are the type that force you to watch, for a long duration, with no option to skip or exit. This wasn’t always the case, but unfortunately, it makes the user experience very annoying now. The app is supposed to be helping people, not frustrating them.

reviews.title: Was good now, too many adds
reviews.text: After taking a hiatus from this app, I decided to reinstall it and now it’s barely usable. There are so many ads when you click on any button and it won’t let you out and redirect you to different game sites or whatever the ad is for it’s impossible to utilize so you have to keep deleting it and reinstalling it and then you get at least half a day of it acting normally, and then the ads pop up again. It used to be a really good app

reviews.title: Used to be good, now riddled with ads
reviews.text: Used to love this app, now it’s an ad every time you want to switch tabs and no way to get rid of the ad. Going to switch to another platform now.

reviews.title: Ads block usage
reviews.text: I have been using this app off and on for years. It always was awesome. There were ads here and there but I didn’t mind as they passed quickly and the app was really helpful. I downloaded it again a week ago and it’s pretty much unusable. Every time I open it and try to se my progress a Vagner app come on and stays there with no way to remove it for over five minutes. I get they need ads but this has made it impossible to use at all.

reviews.title: Could Use Something Better for Cutting Back
reviews.text:
I appreciate the health stuff and all the rewards.  However, it lets me set up to show how many per week to cut down to to get to my goal.  But it basically only gives you the opportunity to show the last drink you took and everything reboots back… there’s no way to input and evaluate how many drinks during the week I’m drinking.  For someone just looking to cut back, there should be some ways to see how those goals are being met…it’s prob much better for someone trying to quit altogether…
This was written by someone else and I 100% agree - I’ve been trying to figure out how to record how much I’m drinking and slowing down.  There’s just a weekly countdown but no way to really apply that countdown unless you keep track elsewhere in which case - why bother with particular app.

reviews.title: Annoying ads
reviews.text: I deleted almost immediately because it had those full screen popup ads that you can’t close. No opinion on the quality of the ap itself because i barely started using it before the ad came on.

reviews.title: Too many apps

reviews.title: Great free app

Many times after over 10 minutes of waiting, I restart my phone-that’s the only way to get back to the content.  Looking for a new app.

reviews.title: Used to be great, too many ads now
reviews.text:
It used to be great, now it’s constant ads.
The ads make me want a drink.

reviews.title: Really helpful app
reviews.text:
This app was super helpful and fun at the beginning of my sobriety.
I really enjoyed looking at my health increase the more days I got sober. I highly recommend it to others to this day, but now I am really disappointed at how many ads I have to watch.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
When I first quit drinking 3 years ago this was a lifesaver. I loved it. Throughout the last 3 years I kept coming back to it for encouragement when I needed it. 

But now, like everything else, it’s plagued with advertisements. You can’t switch tabs without getting a 30 second ad. I get it the people need money to keep it going but it kinda just ruined the whole thing for many people. A year ago I woulda gave it 5 stars, but now I’ll give it a four. And that’s being generous because SERIOUSLY the ads do ruin it. Like actually ruin it.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: I get having to include ads for the free edition, but the ads were intrusive, long, and would always redirect to the app store.  I hit settings and got an ad that wouldn't allow me to skip or exit from (even after 30 seconds).  Avoid this app.  Get the "Days Since" App instead.

reviews.title: What’s with all the ads!!!! I don’t wanna play any games
reviews.text: Every time I turn the app on, it jumps to some game that it wants me to play. I’m getting very frustrated.

reviews.title: Motivation
reviews.text: 2.5 years sober! This app was exactly what I needed. I loved seeing how my health was improving and it really kept me going. I stopped using the app after a year but wanted to come back and give it 5 stars. After 35 years of alcohol abuse, this app kept me motivated.

reviews.title: Too many ads

reviews.title: Great until the ads became ridiculous.
reviews.text: Maybe this was a bug, but most of the ads I got were not skippable after 5-10 seconds like the dev has replied to some comments. They would run incessantly, or generate another ad. I understand the need for ads—I want the developer to generate some revenue after all—but these became far too intrusive. I had to delete the app and that’s a shame because it was truly helpful.
